dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the wide mid-dorsal region toward a sharpened point at the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical convex bulge on the left lateral margin relative to the central axis; right margin exhibits a more linear inward taper.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to near-white median tone indicating a maturing individual.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency grey patches distributed primarily across the anterior and central dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Low-gradient, diffuse transitions between faint grey pigmented regions and the lighter baseline canvas.
